entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A people of human and ogre rebels in the Rushwood on Mercadia who worshipped Ramos.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: The forest where the Cho-Arrim live.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A god of the Cho-Arrim origin myth, victor over Orhop; also a dragon engine they worshipped.

entities.name: Orhop
entities.description: The evil god in the Peliam, vanquished by Ramos.

entities.name: Hassno the Unrighteous
entities.description: A demon who pretended to support Ramos and betrayed him.

entities.name: Saprazzans
entities.description: Tribes that fell into the Outer Sea in the myth.

entities.name: Rishadans
entities.description: Tribes that struck the coastal lands in the myth.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A healer who married into the Cho-Arrim through Cho-Manno.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City whose denizens the Cho-Arrim blamed for a plague.

entities.name: Uniter
entities.description: A prophesied great metal serpent who would unite the children of Ramos.

events.summary: A plague strikes the Cho-Arrim village; they blame Mercadia City, and war seems likely.
events.quote: The villagers blamed the denizens of Mercadia City for this

events.summary: After the Phyrexian invasion, Orim joins the Cho-Arrim through her marriage with Cho-Manno.
events.quote: they were joined by the healer Orim through her marriage with Cho-Manno

relations.quote: Ramos triumphed, and Orhop, the evil god, was vanquished.

relations.note: Fought against oppression by the Mercadians.
relations.quote: fought against the oppression by the Mercadians
